title: cupressus goveniana subsp. abramsiana
intro: Cupressus goveniana subsp. abramsiana, commonly known as the Santa Cruz cypress, is a plant species belonging to the cypress family. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to promote respiratory health and alleviate symptoms associated with bronchitis and coughs. The therapeutic actions of Cupressus goveniana subsp. abramsiana include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its potential health benefits. The bioactive constituents of this plant include terpenes and other volatile compounds, although further research is needed to fully elucidate its chemical composition and pharmacological effects.
